authority: Source code and tests are authoritative; catalog entries are routing hypotheses.

contracts.title: Persisted init/update lifecycle
contracts.summary: runOpenWikiAgent owns preparation, streaming, Claims finalization, completion metadata, crash cleanup, and checkpoint pruning for native runs.
invariants: Claims finalization precedes complete metadata.
A stream or finalization failure records interrupted state without replacing the original error.
failureModes: Cleanup, checkpoint pruning, and interrupted stamping are best-effort secondary operations.
changeSignals: Changing completion ordering requires Claims, metadata, crash-guard, telemetry, and replacement review.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/claims-run-lifecycle.test.ts test/agent/run-metadata.test.ts test/agent/crash-guard.test.ts

contracts.title: Transactional repository init replacement
contracts.summary: Existing repository wiki state is backed up, only safe INSTRUCTIONS.md is initially preserved, and commit occurs after the complete run boundary succeeds.
invariants: No replacement commit occurs before finalization and complete metadata.
Symlinked wiki roots or instructions are refused.
failureModes: Failure or termination restores the old wiki when a backup exists; incomplete rollback is surfaced.
changeSignals: Any new fatal finalizer must execute before replacement commit.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/wiki-replacement.test.ts test/agent/claims-run-lifecycle.test.ts test/integrations/session-manager.test.ts

contracts.title: Message-free repository update no-op
contracts.summary: A repository update skips the model only when prior completion, language, worktree, and Git history prove no meaningful change; Claims still finalize.
invariants: An explicit user message bypasses no-op.
No-op still finalizes Claims and reports noop telemetry.
failureModes: Interrupted prior state, language change, relevant commit, or meaningful worktree change forces work.
changeSignals: Changing ignore or metadata semantics changes the no-op decision matrix.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/update-noop.test.ts test/cli/startup.test.ts

contracts.title: Deep Agent graph and guarded backend
contracts.summary: The low-level graph composes model, tools, middleware, mounts, and checkpoints while the backend independently enforces ignore, docs-only writes, and hidden Claims state.
invariants: Repository init/update writes stay below openwiki/.
Claims sidecars and ignored paths remain unavailable to generic model tools.
failureModes: Active ignore rules disable arbitrary shell execution because shell reads cannot be proven safe.
changeSignals: A new tool or mount requires permission, persistence, event, and prompt review.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/create-openwiki-agent.test.ts test/agent/docs-only-backend.test.ts test/agent/openwiki-ignore.test.ts

contracts.title: Prompt-owned authoring and deterministic finalizers
contracts.summary: Repository authoring combines model-followed planning/review/Claims guidance with code-owned frontmatter, Mermaid, index, link, source, and provenance finalization.
invariants: Material Claims are instructed before factual writes.
Deterministic finalizer order is Mermaid, indexes, links, Claims sources, then generated provenance.
failureModes: Prompt contracts do not mechanically prove model compliance or semantic completeness.
Translation failures are page-local and retryable.
changeSignals: A new finalizer operation affects middleware order, telemetry taxonomy, and tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/prompt.test.ts test/agent/review-subagents.test.ts test/agent/index-middleware.test.ts test/agent/wiki-finalizer.test.ts test/agent/translation-middleware.test.ts

contracts.title: Model provider selection and transport
contracts.summary: A declarative provider registry plus imperative model factory resolves credentials, model identity, availability, retries, reasoning, and provider-specific transports.
invariants: Explicit run model wins over environment and provider default.
Availability unknown warns; unavailable fails.
failureModes: Custom gateways can make provider-family mismatch advisory rather than fatal.
changeSignals: A new provider usually changes registry, credentials UI, factory, availability, diagnostics, and tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/agent/create-model.test.ts test/agent/model-resolution.test.ts test/model-availability.test.ts test/openai-compatible-responses.test.ts

contracts.title: CLI grammar, startup, print, and TUI runtime
contracts.summary: The CLI parses a closed command union, applies mode and startup guards, then dispatches specialized, print, or Ink paths that must preserve orchestration parity.
invariants: Code init/update and personal chat defaults are distinct.
Pre-agent setup and execution stay inside one telemetry wrapper in print and interactive paths.
failureModes: Interactive orchestration parity has less direct integration proof than print mode.
changeSignals: New flags touch parser/help, command types, startup, both run paths, and tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/cli/commands.test.ts test/cli/startup.test.ts test/cli/runners.test.ts test/cli/process-interrupt.test.ts

contracts.title: Atomic Claim mutation and run session
contracts.summary: Claims are atomic evidence-backed propositions; mutations are page-local transactions and ClaimSession owns run-scoped uniqueness, issues, dirtiness, and inspection.
invariants: All evidence resolves before one page's cloned state commits.
A multi-page call is not a cross-page transaction.
failureModes: Duplicate targets, unknown IDs, collisions, empty evidence, and unresolved evidence reject the page batch.
changeSignals: Mutation changes affect native tools, MCP tools, preflight, and persistence.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/claims/core/mutations.test.ts test/claims/brains/code/session.test.ts test/claims/brains/code/tools.test.ts

contracts.title: Repository evidence and Claims sidecars
contracts.summary: Canonical repo:// resources resolve whole files or relocatable line ranges into schema-v1 per-page sidecars with strict containment and atomic writes.
invariants: Generated openwiki content, .git, traversal, symlinks, and physical aliases cannot be evidence.
Sidecar schema remains literal version 1.
failureModes: Missing or ambiguous evidence becomes unresolved; ignored paths and operational failures throw.
changeSignals: Resource version changes affect mutation, preflight, sidecars, and OKF projection.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/claims/evidence/repository/resource.test.ts test/claims/evidence/repository/resolver.test.ts test/claims/brains/code/store.test.ts test/claims/brains/code/preflight.test.ts

contracts.title: Best-effort Claims finalization
contracts.summary: Dirty/deleted/orphan Claim state is rechecked and persisted; recoverable page-local problems warn, security errors fail, and warnings currently do not fail native or host completion.
invariants: Security/containment errors remain fatal.
Claims run only for repository init/update.
Current sidecar schema has no policy field.
failureModes: Recoverable page-local problems are warnings and warning-sink failure is swallowed.
changeSignals: A strict gate must precede complete metadata and init commit while preserving retryable host finish.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/claims/brains/code/runtime.test.ts test/claims/brains/code/session.test.ts test/agent/claims-run-lifecycle.test.ts test/integrations/session-manager.test.ts
gaps: OPENWIKI_CLAIMS_STRICT is not implemented in this checkout.
A future strict mode needs a structured warning taxonomy rather than string matching.

contracts.title: MCP host-authored lifecycle
contracts.summary: Four strict lifecycle tools wrap a serialized session manager for repository authoring, while openwiki_context adds a session-independent read-only retrieval surface.
invariants: Only one operation and one active session exist per manager.
Finish failure before commit leaves the session active for retry.
Unknown transport errors are generic and bounded.
failureModes: Begin failure restores the prior session and init backup; incomplete cleanup is aggregated.
changeSignals: New tools require protocol, server, manager, installed skill, and package updates.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/integrations/protocol.test.ts test/integrations/repository-root.test.ts test/integrations/session-manager.test.ts test/integrations/mcp-server.test.ts test/integrations/mcp-stdio.test.ts

contracts.title: Session-independent host context boundary
contracts.summary: The shipped openwiki_context tool retrieves repository-owned behavior contracts without creating or requiring an init/update lifecycle session.
invariants: Context retrieval is read-only and independent from begin/finish sessions.
The response routes to source and tests but does not return their contents or environment values.
failureModes: No catalog match must mean retrieval gap, never behavior absence.
changeSignals: Tool changes span protocol, safe catalog loading, ranking, MCP guidance, installed skill instructions, and managed agent snippets.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/integrations/context-retrieval.test.ts test/integrations/protocol.test.ts test/integrations/mcp-server.test.ts
gaps: Normal OpenWiki runs do not yet generate the structured context catalog.

contracts.title: Task-oriented context retrieval v2
contracts.summary: A read-only tool ranks structured behavior contracts, expands one relationship hop, exposes match reasons and freshness, and returns bounded source/test routing rather than untrusted file dumps.
invariants: Retrieval confidence is not truth confidence.
Every returned contract includes implementation and proof paths.
Source and tests remain authoritative.
failureModes: Unknown or stale tasks fall back to native source discovery instead of fabricated generic context.
changeSignals: Ranking or response changes require retrieval fixtures, budget/security tests, installed guidance review, and utility evaluation.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/integrations/context-retrieval.test.ts
node openwiki/tools/validate.mjs
node openwiki/tools/context.mjs openwiki_context retrieval
gaps: Freshness is unknown until catalogs carry source-revision provenance.
Catalog generation and task-outcome evaluation remain future work.

contracts.title: Codex and Claude integration installation
contracts.summary: Scoped installation uses contained paths, canonical bundle receipts, surgical JSON/TOML adapters, staging, rollback, backups, and exact managed-state uninstall.
invariants: Unmanaged or modified state is not overwritten without force.
Symlink components and scope escapes are refused.
Unrelated host config bytes/keys are preserved.
failureModes: Commit failure rolls back skill and config; incomplete rollback is aggregated or a backup is retained.
changeSignals: A new host affects registry, CLI, config adapters, producer mapping, bundle, and package tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/integrations/installer.test.ts test/integrations/config-adapters.test.ts test/integrations/skill.test.ts test/integrations/package-contents.test.ts

contracts.title: OKF frontmatter, indexes, sources, and provenance
contracts.summary: OKF v0.2 concept metadata is repaired and finalized deterministically while generated, verified, sources, indexes, and producer extensions retain separate ownership.
invariants: type is the only required concept field.
Body-only changes advance generated provenance.
Claims sidecars remain authoritative over OKF projections.
failureModes: Invalid frontmatter is minimally rebuilt; deterministic finalizer IO errors remain actionable.
changeSignals: Frontmatter edits affect translation, indexing, Claims projection, provenance, and validation.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/okf test/agent/wiki-finalizer.test.ts test/agent/frontmatter-validator.test.ts

contracts.title: Connector registry and acquisition runtime
contracts.summary: Nine registered connectors share private config/state/raw ownership, resilient HTTP, bounded MCP transport, exact discovered tools, and explicit mode scoping.
invariants: Personal connector tools are absent in repository agent runs.
MCP calls use exact discovered names and explicit read-only policy.
Raw reads reject symlinks and escape.
failureModes: HTTP retries only bounded transient classes; auth/ordinary 4xx return directly.
changeSignals: A connector change spans adapter, registry, config/state, auth/onboarding, ingestion, and tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/connectors test/ingestion/ingestion.test.ts test/ingestion/code-mode.test.ts

contracts.title: Sequential personal-source ingestion
contracts.summary: Each configured personal source runs deterministic acquisition followed by source-scoped local-wiki synthesis; failures are isolated and sources execute sequentially.
invariants: A deterministic error with no raw files skips synthesis for that source.
One source failure does not prevent later sources.
failureModes: Agent output files are prevalidated but concurrent disk writes are not transactionally atomic.
changeSignals: Orchestration changes affect target parsing, source state, telemetry, prompts, and isolation.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/ingestion/ingestion.test.ts test/ingestion/ingestion-run.test.ts

contracts.title: Repository setup and code connector augmentation
contracts.summary: Code mode refreshes managed agent instructions, creates the scheduled workflow only on init when absent, and fail-open augments authoring with LangSmith observations.
invariants: Existing scheduled workflow content is preserved.
Code connector failure cannot block source-based wiki generation.
failureModes: Missing or invalid last-update time removes the ingestion floor.
changeSignals: Managed-block ownership and create-on-init semantics need regression proof.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/ingestion/code-mode.test.ts test/ingestion/langsmith-modes.test.ts

contracts.title: OAuth, provider credentials, and setup state
contracts.summary: Connector OAuth and model authentication are distinct; private environment saves are serialized and atomic, and readiness requires credentials plus mode-specific onboarding.
invariants: Process environment overrides saved values.
OAuth discovery validates every candidate endpoint.
Secrets remain outside connector config and committed files.
failureModes: Windows ACL hardening is best-effort; unsafe redirects and invalid discovery are hard failures.
changeSignals: Auth changes span registry, redirect/discovery, persistence, setup gates, diagnostics, and tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/auth test/config/env.test.ts test/config/env-behavior.test.ts test/setup

contracts.title: Private and repository state ownership
contracts.summary: OpenWiki separates private home credentials, personal wiki, connector state, history, and skills from repository wiki, Claims, metadata, workflow, and managed instruction blocks.
invariants: Shell environment wins over saved env.
Generic authoring cannot own Claims sidecars or run metadata.
Chat uses persistent checkpoints; init/update use memory.
failureModes: Checkpoint pruning and some permission hardening are nonfatal maintenance.
changeSignals: New environment keys require managed registry, secrecy, persistence, diagnostics, and setup decisions.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/config test/agent/checkpoint-policy.test.ts test/agent/run-metadata.test.ts

contracts.title: Personal launchd and repository CI schedules
contracts.summary: One global personal ingestion schedule is stored everywhere but installed only on macOS when cron maps to launchd; repository updates use CI workflows.
invariants: Unsupported OS or complex cron saves with a warning instead of claiming installation.
Existing repository workflow is preserved.
failureModes: Live launchd/pmset behavior is mostly mocked and remains an operational validation gap.
changeSignals: Personal scheduling and repository CI are separate ownership paths.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/scheduling test/ingestion/code-mode.test.ts test/cli/schedule-format.test.ts

contracts.title: Exactly-once anonymous run telemetry
contracts.summary: Init/update setup, connectors, and agent execution sit inside one best-effort telemetry wrapper with closed payloads, opt-outs, anonymous identity, and normalized failures.
invariants: Telemetry never replaces the original run result or error.
Payloads exclude raw errors, prompts, paths, repository facts, and secret values.
failureModes: Unknown operation details are dropped by allowlists; connector errors swallowed upstream are blind spots.
changeSignals: New lifecycle errors need throw-site ownership, taxonomy allowlist, payload tests, and disclosure review.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/telemetry test/cli/telemetry-cli.test.ts

contracts.title: Visualizer and Mermaid degradation
contracts.summary: A no-symlink wiki graph feeds a loopback-only live server or static export, while finalization validates Mermaid and degrades invalid diagrams without losing content.
invariants: The live server binds loopback only.
Graph traversal and page reads do not follow symlinks.
Invalid Mermaid content survives in a text fence.
failureModes: Static export still requires pinned CDN assets and is not offline.
changeSignals: Browser asset changes require both TypeScript builds, copy/package tests, and server/export parity.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/visualize test/mermaid test/copy-visualize-assets.test.ts

contracts.title: Platform, containment, redaction, and portability
contracts.summary: Node/ESM and cross-platform helpers centralize path normalization, filesystem race classification, language, diagnostics, and best-effort Windows ACL hardening.
invariants: Security boundaries normalize and physically resolve paths.
Node and browser TypeScript surfaces remain separate.
failureModes: Windows ACL failure is nonfatal; evidence/store/installer containment failure is fatal.
Exact-value redaction covers known managed secrets and must not be treated as complete leak prevention.
changeSignals: New secret shapes belong in the shared key/value redaction boundary and negative tests.
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/platform test/config/openwiki-home.test.ts test/agent/redaction.test.ts
pnpm run typecheck

contracts.title: Build, package, and release integrity
contracts.summary: Node and browser compilers, explicit asset copying, package allowlists, build-channel stamping, CI matrices, Changesets, and OIDC publishing define shipped bytes.
invariants: Published files are allowlisted.
Ordinary builds remain community channel.
Canonical integration skill content is packaged without local state.
failureModes: Adding a source or asset without copy/package coverage can pass typecheck but ship incomplete output.
changeSignals: Runtime entrypoint, browser asset, package file, or release changes require build/package proof.
validation: pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build
pnpm exec vitest run test/copy-visualize-assets.test.ts test/stamp-build-channel.test.ts test/integrations/package-contents.test.ts

contracts.title: Contract-oriented testing strategy
contracts.summary: Vitest suites mirror ownership, cross-system lifecycle tests prove durable ordering, and validation widens from focused tests through typecheck/build/lint to the full suite.
invariants: Failure tests assert durable state when rollback, retry, or metadata are contractual.
Live/evaluation tests are not routine correctness gates.
failureModes: A narrow unit test can miss caller, persistence, packaging, or duplicated-orchestration contracts.
changeSignals: Select tests by changed contract and direct consumers, not filename alone.
validation: pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run lint:check
pnpm test

contracts.title: LEDGER longitudinal grounding evaluation
contracts.summary: LEDGER replays Git checkpoints, runs init then updates, extracts every current factual claim, resolves source, and scores supported, stale, invented, and unverified states.
invariants: Each checkpoint recomputes the partition over the current wiki.
Evidence maps route but do not encode answers.
failureModes: Evaluator failure degrades completeness and remains auditable rather than becoming a favorable label.
changeSignals: Metric changes require partition, denominator, persistence, report, and meta-evaluator review.
validation: pnpm run eval:ledger:typecheck
pnpm exec vitest run evals/ledger

contracts.title: DeepSWE paired coding-agent evaluation
contracts.summary: The DeepSWE harness compares identical baseline and OpenWiki-treated Codex tasks while isolating wiki generation, held-out verification, credentials, networking, patches, and caches.
invariants: Both conditions receive the same task/model/seed/attempts.
Treatment artifacts are excluded from the submitted patch.
Held-out tests remain offline.
failureModes: Live trials require credentials, network, pinned external tools, and explicit cost authorization.
changeSignals: Treatment changes need contamination, cache-key, network, credential, and patch-exclusion review.
validation: uvx --from pytest pytest evals/deepswe/tests
